caption: Timeline from 12° before TDC to the end of late burning. Ignition delay covers injection to 2.4° after TDC; the next bars show premixed, mixing-controlled and late burning.

spec.aria: A timeline from 12 degrees before TDC: ignition delay ends at 2.4 degrees after TDC, premixed burn ends at 10.4 degrees, mixing-controlled burn ends at 40.4 degrees, and late burning ends at 55.4 degrees.
